name: HeartFlow FFR-CT (In Silico Twin)
description: HeartFlow FFR-CT is an FDA-cleared in silico twin that models coronary physiology non-invasively from CT scans to guide clinical decisions about coronary artery disease. It integrates mechanistic computational fluid dynamics models with patient-specific CT data, generating a bidirectional, continuously personalizing digital replica of the patient's coronary system. Validated in trials with over 2,500 patients, it serves as both a clinical decision support tool and a model for high-fidelity in silico evaluation of diagnostic algorithms.
reputation: FDA-cleared; validated in trials with >2,500 patients; considered a leading example of in silico twin technology for clinical decision support.
notes: Represents the in silico twin (IST) paradigm: bidirectional data flow, real-time personalization, and direct integration into clinical decision loops. Governed by FDA V&V40/EMA M&S Framework for regulatory qualification. Not a traditional AI benchmark but an evaluation platform for diagnostic algorithms.
